ex.s: Even those who didn’t share that interest with me seemed more engaged once I showed a different side of myself.

ex.s: So, we pay more attention to them.

ex.s: Putting more effort into renewables.

ex.t: 以下是一些值得遵循的、能让你沟通更有效的建议。

ex.t: 有些选择很快就能做出，而另一些则需要更多思考。

ex.t: 这些努力帮助我们更负责任地旅行。

ex.t: 不久前，在一个寒冷的冬夜，有一个想要更多屏幕时间的少年，和一位说“不行”的家长。

ex.s: When reading texts of several hundred words or more, learning is generally more successful when it’s on paper than onscreen.

ex.t: 所以我绝对相信，仅因为短篇故事我们就会迎来更多乘客，”她说。

ex.src: 2024全国甲卷·第四部分 写作
ex.t: 这里的氛围让这顿饭更加令人享受。

ex.t: 为了给一些有才华的演员留下印象、让他们免费来为我工作，我在沙发上铺了些盖毯、点了蜡烛，让地方显得更“年轻职业范儿”一些。

ex.s: Therefore, just as we need to be more thoughtful about our caloric consumption, we also need to be more thoughtful about our information consumption, resisting the temptation of the mental “junk food” in order to manage our time most effectively.
ex.t: 因此，正如我们需要更审慎地对待热量摄入，我们也需要更审慎地对待信息摄入，抵制精神“垃圾食品”的诱惑，以最有效地管理时间。

ex.t: 由于这些空间充满了坚实的冰，液态水不容易进入其中，但当永久冻土融化时就可以，从而让更多的水渗透过去。

ex.s: In recent years, I’ve been trying to show up for her more, in person.
ex.t: 近年来，我一直在努力更多地亲自陪在她身边。

ex.s: The school grew in popularity so quickly that Drewry realized she would need more space outside her home for the classes.
ex.t: 这所学校迅速走红，德鲁里意识到她需要在家以外找更大的空间来上课。

ex.s: Teaching kids, especially those picky eaters, to cook helps a lot because they’re more willing to eat something made by themselves.
ex.t: 教孩子们，尤其是那些挑食的孩子做饭大有好处，因为他们更愿意吃自己做的东西。

ex.s: More importantly, it is also about releasing children into the world with a life skill they’ll need as an adult when they’re no longer in their parents’ care.
ex.t: 更重要的是，这也是让孩子们带着一项生活技能走向世界，这项技能在他们长大、不再受父母照顾时会用得上。

ex.s: More generally, social instincts motivate us to learn how to behave in a socially complex world.
ex.t: 更普遍地说，社会本能促使我们学习如何在这个社会复杂的世界中行事。

ex.s: They are more likely to remember people’s mistakes.
ex.t: 他们更容易记住人们的错误。

ex.t: 几个月后，当我在自己的实验室重复这项实验时，我产出了更多可发表的数据。

ex.s: You see much more from the seat of a bike!
ex.t: 坐在自行车上你能看到更多的风景！

ex.t: 2.5小时的游览涵盖古伊风车、瘦桥、国立博物馆、喜力啤酒厂等地。

ex.s: When enough of these errors are averaged together, they cancel each other out, resulting in a more accurate estimate.
ex.t: 当足够多的这类误差被平均在一起时，它们会相互抵消，从而得到更准确的估计。

ex.s: In more technical terms, the wisdom of crowds requires that people’s estimates be independent.
ex.t: 用更专业的术语来说，群体智慧要求人们的估算相互独立。

ex.s: Program evaluations show that kids eat more vegetables as a result of the classes.
ex.t: 项目评估显示，由于这些课程，孩子们吃了更多的蔬菜。

ex.s: Back downtown during a workday, they can enjoy a more domestic form of this interaction by walking along a fountain on their lunch break.
ex.t: 回到市中心的上班日，他们可以在午休时间沿着喷泉散步，享受这种互动的一种更居家化的形式。

ex.t: 它的花费越来越高。

ex.t: 它变得越来越耗时。

ex.s: As grizzly bears expand their range into places where they haven’t been seen in a century or more, they’re increasingly being sighted by humans.
ex.t: 随着灰熊的活动范围扩展到它们一个多世纪未见的地方，它们越来越多地被人类看到。

ex.s: The western half of the US was full of grizzlies when Europeans came, with a rough number of 50,000 or more living alongside Native Americans.
ex.t: 当欧洲人到来时，美国西部半壁到处都是灰熊，大约有5万只或更多与美洲原住民比邻而居。

ex.s: Today, there are about 2,000 or more grizzly bears in the US Their recovery has been so successful that the US Fish and Wildlife Service has twice attempted to delist grizzlies, which would loosen legal protections and allow them to be hunted.
ex.t: 如今，美国大约有2000只或更多的灰熊。它们的恢复如此成功，以至于美国鱼类和野生动物管理局曾两次试图将灰熊从保护名录中移除，这将放松法律保护并允许捕猎它们。

ex.s: You’ll soon find that the more patience you practice, the more you start to apply it to other, more annoying situations.
ex.t: 你很快就会发现，你练习的耐心越多，你就越开始把它运用到其他更恼人的情境中。

ex.s: It can also help us practice more patience
ex.t: 它还能帮助我们练习更多的耐心

ex.s: Even though Britain has a reputation for less-than-impressive cuisine, it is producing more top class chefs who appear frequently on our television screens and whose recipe books frequently top the best seller lists.
ex.t: 尽管英国以平庸的烹饪闻名，但它正在培养出更多一流厨师，他们频繁出现在电视屏幕上，其食谱书也经常登上畅销榜榜首。

ex.s: One in four adults say that TV chefs have made them much more confident about expanding their cookery knowledge and skills, and young people are also getting more interested in cooking.
ex.t: 四分之一的成年人说，电视上的厨师让他们对拓展自己的烹饪知识和技能更有信心，年轻人也对烹饪越来越感兴趣。

ex.s: Which is the percentage of the people using more diverse ingredients now?
ex.t: 现在使用更多样化食材的人占多大比例？

ex.s: What’s more, indoor plants are easy to look after and are not very expensive.
ex.t: 而且，室内植物好养，也不贵。

ex.s: Chances are that if you’re looking to live a more sustainable lifestyle, not everyone around you will be ready to jump on that bandwagon.
ex.t: 很可能，如果你想过上更可持续的生活，你周围并非所有人都会准备好跟上这股潮流。

ex.s: If you have individuals who are not on board, your words probably won’t do much and can often leave you feeling more discouraged.
ex.t: 如果有不支持你的人，你说的话可能起不了多大作用，而且往往让你更加沮丧。

ex.s: But all of that growth will take up a lot of space, and though more and more people accept the concept of solar energy, few like large solar panels to be installed near them.
ex.t: 但所有这些增长都会占用大量空间，而且尽管越来越多的人接受太阳能的概念，却很少有人喜欢附近安装大型太阳能板。

ex.s: I couldn’t agree more
ex.t: 我完全同意

ex.t: 对于艺术家创作的图像，观众一旦知道创作它们所用的过程，就可能获得远为更多的享受。

ex.s: Informed by neuroaesthetics, the next time I create my art I will value the process even more, enjoying the activation of the aesthetic triad in my brain as I admire the vivid images that I have created.
ex.t: 在神经美学启发下，下次我创作艺术时会更重视过程，享受大脑中审美三联体被激活，同时欣赏我创造的生动图像。

ex.t: 然而，在"不情愿"的情境中，狗看实验员的次数更少，坐下、躺下和四处走动的频率更高。

ex.t: 现在有更多证据表明，狗能够区分与不同意图相关的相似行为。

ex.t: 无法关注长期的原因和后果导致了一些世界上最严重的问题：气候变化、生物多样性丧失等等。

ex.s: For instance, you might hear someone say: “It’s cold this winter, so I needn’t worry about global warming.”Another is that loud and urgent matters are given too much importance, making people ignore longer-term trends that arguably matter more.
ex.t: 例如，你可能听到有人说：“今年冬天很冷，所以我不用为全球变暖担心。”另一个问题是，喧闹而紧迫的事被赋予过多重要性，使人们忽视了 arguably 更重要的长期趋势。

ex.s: This is when a pop star draws far more attention than, say, gradual biodiversity decline.
